title: Miam Miam Chef Ai
tagline: Miam Miam Chef AI is your AI-powered meal planner, crafting personalized weekly menus with smart nutrition and Web3 integration. Say goodbye to meal stress and hello to effortless, delicious eating—tailored just for you.
description: Miam Miam Chef AI is an AI-powered meal planner that creates personalized weekly menus based on dietary needs, preferences, and nutrition goals. Built with Eliza and Autonome. The next upgrade will be to have tokenized rewards for user who keep their recipes healthy. The user can login using privy then discuss with the chef some recipes he/she would love to have.
how_its_made:
Miam Miam Chef AI is built using a combination of AI, Web3, and decentralized automation, leveraging Eliza and Autonome as core components. The system is designed to provide personalized weekly meal plans while integrating blockchain-based incentives for healthy eating.

At its core, Eliza powers the AI’s natural language interactions, allowing users to communicate seamlessly with the meal planner in a way that feels intuitive and engaging. This ensures users receive context-aware meal suggestions and nutritional advice tailored to their dietary needs.

Autonome plays a key role in managing the autonomous execution of meal planning tasks, ensuring that Miam Miam Chef AI can operate efficiently without centralized control. This allows the system to scale, offering smart meal recommendations and adjusting based on real-time user preferences.

For the backend, the project uses a lightweight AI engine trained on extensive recipe, nutrition, and ingredient data, enabling it to generate meal plans that balance flavor, nutrition, and variety. The AI considers dietary restrictions, personal preferences, and available ingredients when crafting meal suggestions.
